touches.text: The abstract ticket owns what every kind shares: its birth (cast), its plan file and its trail (the log beside it).
Coding Ticket: what we usually mean.
Has its own workflow stamped on it (the state string, with the cursor).
Carries its WATCHME spec.
Lives in CairnCommons/tickets/ while staged; its trail migrates beside its code as that component's history while under way, and back to the commons after (Law 5).
harbor_master (machine)

Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve, and the tester (11; Q#33, Akien 2026-10-29). (Not diagnostic_inspector: it is base's, 17.3.) The code pipeline's inspectors and gates move to CodeMother; any that are not about code (if such existed) would not. (Q#31, Akien 2026-10-27)
TESTER MACHINE, CodeMother's (was the tester device, cairn/devices/tester/)
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)

rehearsal: the cheapest model reads a ticket cold three times and tries to build it on paper, so "buildable as written" is measured. → CodeMother Its point is "what questions does the plan not answer". So it is handed the plan steps, the frame (intention, why, falsifier), and what exists and what does not, measured before the read; each step answers builds or stopped, with what is missing. "Cold" means no conversation, history, chart or process, not blind to the disk. (Akien 2026-10-29, open-692f24d32b18.)
skill_block: the door a skill's firing passes through, so a skill can't skip its gate. [Q#42: belongs to CC (skills are Claude Code's), or CodeMother (workflows)?]
base
artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). USERS: everyone who writes a record.
chain: the grammar every chart stage speaks. [Q#50: → CodeMother tool (its machines are the only real users)?]
gate: the == compare, in one place. A gate opens when every expected equals its actual. No oracle, ever.
operator_inbox: builds the operator's to-do list from live state. → Operator's machine (8.2.7)
question: the open-question door: a decision only you can make, bound to its ticket, answered in your words. → Ticket (3.3.5)? Operator?
intentions_model_compiler: copies every intention into intentions-congruency-lab/, so that folder can regrow the system on a bare machine. → Cairn
proof_coverage: joins a ticket's falsifier clauses to the proofs that cover them and the seals that ran green. → Tester
ticket_inspector: completeness checks over tickets at rest. → CodeMother
